_comment: FROZEN designer output for the Q11 spike. The creative (designer) stage is exempt from verdict 3 per the Q2<->Q11 audit resolution, so this file is committed and the transliterator reads ONLY this. Regenerating it is a designer act, not a transliteration act. NOTE: anatomyNodeId values are PROVISIONAL — the vocabulary has no closed set and no ratified home (see docs/plans/q11-shell-spike.md, F3).

shells.label: startup
shells.intro: The startup shell's outer frame. It holds a nested-router outlet that the startup leaf (boot logic + loading UI) renders through.

surfaces.label: splashscreen
surfaces.role: the mobile-device splash surface — brand logo only
surfaces.intro: The splash surface. Brand logo only: no navigation, no copy, no controls. It is a surface, never a shell.

shells.label: unknown
shells.intro: The unknown shell's outer frame. It is the terminal fallback the router resolves when no other route matches.

surfaces.label: not found
surfaces.intro: The not-found surface. It explains that the requested route does not resolve and offers the way back.

shells.label: auth
shells.intro: The auth shell's outer frame. It holds a nested-router outlet that each credential surface renders through.

surfaces.label: sign in
surfaces.intro: The sign-in surface. It captures an existing credential and forwards it to the session facade.

surfaces.label: sign up
surfaces.intro: The sign-up surface. It captures the fields a new account requires and forwards them to the session facade.

shells.label: application
shells.intro: The application shell's outer frame. It holds the persistent chrome and a nested-router outlet each authenticated surface renders through.

surfaces.label: home
surfaces.intro: The home surface. It is the first authenticated surface a signed-in user lands on.

surfaces.label: settings
surfaces.intro: The settings surface. It presents account and preference controls for the signed-in user.

shells.label: design
shells.intro: The design shell's outer frame. It holds a nested-router outlet each design-system surface renders through.

surfaces.label: tokens
surfaces.intro: The tokens surface. It renders the active token set so the values can be inspected against the design.

surfaces.label: components
surfaces.intro: The components surface. It renders kit components in their default states for visual inspection.
